connectorNamingNote: Verified 2026-10-30: `deployableConnectors` lists the connector DIRECTORY names from `SQL/dataconnect/dataconnect.yaml` because that is what `SQL/scripts/release-check.cjs` compares (`connectorDirs`). The deployed Firebase connector IDs are declared in each `connector.yaml`: directory `clinic` -> id `clinic`, directory `admin` -> id `clinic-admin`. Renaming `admin` to `clinic-admin` here would make the source guard report `UNACCOUNTED_CONNECTOR` for the `admin` directory, so the IDs are recorded in `connectorIds` instead of replacing the directory list.
